main_text.l: esse exclusum. Audit Deum esse summè Justum, statim suum inde elicit commodum, & Deum suo etiam bono Justum credit. Audit Deum esse summè Veracem, confugit itaq; ad veritatem Dei, quam sibi quoq; applicat, & Deum in promis-sis suis sibi veracem nullus dubitat: & ita deinceps. Sic itaq; fides Deum respicit, ut suum & sibi promissum Deum. Omniaque Dei sua facit, & bono suo applicare studet.

II. Mediatorem proprie respicit Fides salvifica, quatenus est animi fiducia in Jesu Christo ejusq; merito penitus acquiescens. Fide enim fidelis credit in Jesum Christum, sibi, & in suum bonum ad salutem suam conceptum, natum, passum, crucifixum, mortuum, sepultum, redivivum, cœlos conscendentem, ad dextram Dei Patris sedentem, & novissimo die ad judicium reditūrum, Hunc Jesum totum fidelis per fidem sibi applicat, & pro suis peccatis satisfecisse, certò statuit.
Ergò fides Christianorum salvifica versatur in Christo Jesu rectè cogno-icen-

page.notes: The small mark at the top right corner ("111" or "112") is unclear and may be a stamp or handwriting; it is left out. The running head page number reads "17" but is partly unclear. "promis-sis" and "promissum" are read with a contracted p, so the spelling is uncertain. The final word is broken across the last two lines ("cogno-" / "icen-") and its completion is not on this page. The note "Fidei respi-" / "ut Christū." is split over two lines and is transcribed as two notes.
